projects.title: A chat room that needs nothing
projects.description: The board makes its own WiFi and everyone in range chats on it. No router, no internet, no account.
projects.after: Join the WiFi devkit-chat and open http://192.168.4.1

projects.title: A remote for the whole machine
projects.description: Pairs to a laptop as a Bluetooth keyboard and serves the buttons to your phone over WiFi: slides, media keys, typing.
projects.after: Pair devkit-remote from the laptop's Bluetooth settings, then join the WiFi devkit-remote on your phone

projects.title: Tic-tac-toe with a short memory
projects.description: Two phones, rooms by code, the board as referee. Classic, or vanishing: three marks each, the oldest disappears.
projects.after: Join the WiFi devkit-xo and open http://192.168.4.1

projects.title: Hide the board
projects.description: A hot-and-cold hunt for the board itself: each phone's meter warms as the board hears it louder. Press BOOT to claim it.
projects.after: Move the board to a power bank, then join the WiFi devkit-hide and open http://192.168.4.1

projects.title: Dots and boxes
projects.description: Two to four players, 4×4, 6×6 or 9×9. Close a box and you go again; the board keeps score.
projects.after: Join the WiFi devkit-boxes and open http://192.168.4.1
